gaps.lead: Most of the children ignored what the teacher had told them.
gaps.sentence: Few of the children ___ what the teacher had told them.

gaps.lead: Barbara's parents were certain that she would be a great tennis player.
gaps.sentence: Barbara's parents were ___ that she would be a great tennis player.

gaps.lead: I think learning to use a typewriter is a waste of time.
gaps.sentence: I can't ___ how to use a typewriter.
gaps.explanation: 'A waste of time' becomes 'can't see the point in/of doing it'.

gaps.lead: People say the castle is haunted.
gaps.explanation: People say X is… → X is said to be…

gaps.lead: The staff wear a uniform at all times.
gaps.sentence: The staff ___ a uniform at all times.

gaps.lead: Assembling the wardrobe took me two hours.
gaps.explanation: it took me X to do = I spent X doing.

gaps.lead: I regret not bringing an umbrella.
gaps.explanation: Regret about the past: wish + subject + had + participle.

gaps.lead: I want you to stop tapping your pen while I am working.
gaps.sentence: I ___ tapping your pen while I am working.
gaps.explanation: 'I want you to stop' becomes 'I wish you would stop' — wish + would for irritation.
